sentences.en: We are estranged, and I want to know why.
sentences.zh: 我们疏远了，我想知道原因。

sentences.en: Yanni tried to limit his kids' contact with his estranged wife.
sentences.zh: 亚尼试图限制他与离异妻子的联系。

sentences.en: A quarrel estranged one boy from the other.
sentences.zh: 一场争执让一个男孩与另一个男孩疏远开来。

senses.zh: 使疏远，离间，使感情失和

mnemonic: 词根记忆：e（加强）+strange（陌生）→使…陌生→使疏远
